review_mode: READ_ONLY_SOURCE_INSPECTION; no replay execution performed by this review

assessments.fresh_confirmation_not_claimed: Primary uses --development-seed without --confirm; successor uses --replay-seed and explicitly requires exposed mode and zero new protected worlds. Original case truths must match exactly.
assessments.actual_work_reexecuted: Invokes native EPANET construction, all named candidate/control plans, primary runtime replay, original Net3 rejection, complete derivative feasibility, simulated commercial execution with fresh independent audit, successor construction and runtime verification.
assessments.comparison_exclusions: Only explicit wall/process timing and peak RSS fields are removed. Changed acceptance exposure/count fields are separately checked. Successor raw plan and simulation-receipt hashes are omitted only after complete non-timing plan/receipt semantics are compared.
assessments.source_authority: Fixed source/input pins, frozen manifests and successor replay manifest bindings precede execution. Source-module origins are checked within extraction. Original evidence archive restoration checks complete member identities and refuses differing overwrites. All remembered source/input hashes are rechecked at end.
assessments.failed_work_retained: Original Net3 TRACE_PERCENT_RANGE rejection and every range witness must reproduce. Reproduction disagreement writes an explicit witness and stops. Partial/preflight runs cannot claim full replay.
assessments.case_denominators: All original primary case truths and all successor case truths are required equal; all five drift levels and all three arms retained in complete acceptance comparison.

remaining_gate: A real clean downloaded extraction must still execute to completion under a declared resource allocation. This source review is not current-head or downloaded-release execution qualification.
limitations: Procedural inspection on shared host, not outside certification.
Dependency versions are checked; this is not a supply-chain audit or sandbox.
No-network field describes the script code paths; this review did not perform independent network telemetry.
